moments.cue: A ghostly brigantine drifts empty, cargo untouched
Built in Canada in 1861, the Mary Celeste later sailed under the American flag
On December 4, 1872, the Dei Gratia found her near the Azores, lifeboat missing
Today, Mary Celeste stands as a symbol of the sea’s unsolved mysteries
